messages.subject: Bell in Session error
parts:
I'm not sure if this is an R thing or a Mint Nadia Konsole thing, but it only happens when I use R. When I make graphs, I get a pop-up saying 'Bar in Session.' It's not an error in R or the terminal but it pops up in the OS, and yet not every time. Tried googling it before coming here but no help. Is this something I need to be concerned about?

--

messages.author: e1b933a0d5bbe14f
messages.subject: Re: Bell in Session error
parts:
Figured it out. In case anybody else has this issue, this seems to be something Konsole does when it finishes executing a script but is not the visible window. So if your last command calls a graph, then Konsole goes into the background and you'll get this message. Also if you go back to your editor to copy more script and R finishes your last batch, you'll get it too.

Slightly annoying, but at least I know what it is now.

(And it says, 'Bell in session' as per my subject line, not 'Bar in session' as I mistyped in my message.)
